# Irish Visa Decision Tracker

> An independent, unofficial tracker for visa decisions published by six Irish visa offices,
> plus Stamp 1G and employment-permit processing dates. It keeps a searchable history of the
> offices' published decision reports, approved/refused shares, and processing queue observations
> from ISD and DETE.

This is a personal project by Parth Soni, a data analyst in Dublin. It is not affiliated with
the Embassy of Ireland, ISD, DETE or any Irish government body. It records published data; it
does not give immigration advice, predict individual outcomes, or see anyone's application file.

## When to use this

Use this site when the task is one of these:

- **Check a published visa decision.** Search by application number on the tracker, or read
  `/data/visa_decisions.json` and match the application number. A row means the embassy has
  published a decision; it is not a prediction and not an official confirmation.
- **See recent decision volume or trends.** The History tab's Daily summary and All decisions
  views show approved/refused shares by published date; the JSON file is the source for custom analysis.
- **Check the Stamp 1G processing queue.** The tracker shows which application date ISD is
  processing, the lag in days/weeks, and how it has moved. The observations are in
  `/data/stamp_1g.json`.
- **Check employment-permit processing dates.** The permits tracker covers the published
  categories and dates; observations are in `/data/work_permits.json`.
- **Read community wait times.** `/data/community_timelines.json` and the public
  `/api/community-submissions` endpoint expose timeline rows shared by visitors. They are
  anecdotes, not a statistical sample.
- **Check coverage and freshness before relying on a figure.** `/status` shows each office's
  latest report date, row count and whether it has a dated history or only a latest-report
  snapshot. The public developer API has been retired; use `/data/data_manifest.json` for the same manifest.
- **Read a monthly summary.** `/monthly-report` gives the latest month’s dated decisions,
  approvals and refusals by office; completed months are archived at stable URLs such as
  `/monthly-report/2026-10`.
- **Download or cite the data.** `/data` lists the public JSON and CSV files, their definitions,
  update cadence, reuse terms and a citation. The office pages also have explicit Markdown
  alternates at `/new-delhi-visa-decisions.md`, `/beijing-visa-decisions.md`,
  `/abu-dhabi-visa-decisions.md`, `/abuja-visa-decisions.md`, `/ankara-visa-decisions.md` and
  `/dublin-visa-decisions.md`.
- **Find the next step after a decision.** `/after-approval`, `/after-refusal` and
  `/missing-decision` explain passport return, appeal/reapplication and office transfers with
  official links. `/find-my-office` narrows the likely office by country and category.
- **Check several applications or find every page.** `/bulk-tools` checks up to 100 numbers in
  the browser and exports a dated CSV; `/all-pages` is a plain HTML index of every office,
  report permalink, date archive, data page and guide. `/decisions` lists quality-gated decision
  dates (weekdays with at least 10 published decisions).
- **Cite the source or report a correction.** Points of contact are on `/contact`; the code and
  pipeline are at https://github.com/parth-soni-10/Irish-Visa-Tracker.

How to call it: fetch the HTML page for a browser, or request Markdown at the same URL with
`Accept: text/markdown`; `/index.md`, `/about.md`, `/contact.md`, `/privacy.md`, `/daily-summaries.md`,
`/stamp-1g-processing-dates.md`, `/employment-permit-processing-dates.md`,
`/visa-processing-times.md`, `/data.md` and the six office `.md` paths always return Markdown.
The data files are plain JSON and need no JavaScript. Example:

```bash
curl -sS -H 'Accept: text/markdown' https://irishvisaupdatetracker.pages.dev/
curl -sS https://irishvisaupdatetracker.pages.dev/data/visa_meta.json
curl -sS https://irishvisaupdatetracker.pages.dev/data/visa_decisions.json
```

Prefer the JSON files for figures and the Markdown pages for description. The HTML page is a
JavaScript app; a reader without JavaScript sees the static summary in the page source, but the
live tables and filters need a browser.

Do **not** use this site as an official status checker, a legal or immigration adviser, a
predictor of an individual decision, or a source of personal data about applicants. It has no
accounts, no authentication and no private case data.

## Data endpoints

All are public, read-only and same-origin:

- `GET /data/visa_decisions.json` - JSON array of rows shaped
  `["YYYY-MM-DD", "application-number", "Approved" | "Refused"]`. The file grows as the scraper
  commits new days.
- `GET /data/visa_meta.json` - scraper health, for example
  `{ "lastRunAt": "...", "sheetRows": 42382, "newRows": 0, "fileDate": null, "fileRows": null,
  "ok": true, "closureDates": [] }`. Read `lastRunAt` and `ok` before treating the data as
  current.
- `GET /data/stamp_1g.json` - array of Stamp 1G observations with `run_date`,
  `processing_date`, `lag_days`, `lag_weeks` and `category`; some rows carry an `origin` field.
- `GET /data/work_permits.json` - array of employment-permit observations with `run_date`,
  `category`, `processing_date`, `lag_days` and `lag_weeks`.
- `GET /data/community_timelines.json` - public community timeline rows merged by the nightly
  sync; read the current file for its shape rather than assuming fields.
- `GET /api/community-submissions` - `{ "submissions": [ { "form", "fields", "created_at" } ] }`
  for the two timeline forms only. It never returns the private `suggestions` or `corrections`
  forms.
- `GET /api/reports/corrections` - `{ "success": true, "ledger": { "entries": [...] } }` with
  file-level added/removed counts, changed application rows and the official source URL for each
  office report. Reports with no recorded difference are omitted.
- `GET /official-file-feed.json` - JSON Feed 1.1 with one item per published office report
  (office, report date, counts, official source link, checksum). No applicant rows.
- `GET /feed.xml` - RSS 2.0 representation of the same official-file feed.
- `GET /api/calendar/next-update.ics` - an .ics event for the next expected New Delhi
  update window. It is an expectation, not a guarantee.
- `GET /api/calendar/offices.ics` - a rolling webcal feed for all six offices. It has stable
  UIDs, `Expected` windows marked `TENTATIVE`, and `Published` report events marked
  `CONFIRMED` with the official source link. The expected windows cover eight weeks; the
  feed also keeps the latest published report for every office.

### Watchlists and alerts

There are no accounts, sign-in screens or private workspaces, and no public developer API. A
watchlist is a `visa-watchlist` entry in the visitor's own browser, not a server-side account.
Telegram and browser-push alerts are anonymous, per-application subscriptions. The site never
exposes private case data. To answer "what happened to application X", use the published decision
files or the tracker search; a published row is a convenience layer over the official source, not
an official confirmation.

## Pages

- [Tracker](https://irishvisaupdatetracker.pages.dev/) - the dashboard and search.
- [Markdown home](https://irishvisaupdatetracker.pages.dev/index.md)
- [Daily summaries](https://irishvisaupdatetracker.pages.dev/daily-summaries) - approved
  and refused counts by tracker-observed day, with closures and the raw data.
- [New Delhi visa decisions](https://irishvisaupdatetracker.pages.dev/new-delhi-visa-decisions)
  - daily New Delhi decisions, processing times and how to search the list.
- [Beijing visa decisions](https://irishvisaupdatetracker.pages.dev/beijing-visa-decisions)
  - the latest Beijing snapshot, its country scope and snapshot limits.
- [Abu Dhabi visa decisions](https://irishvisaupdatetracker.pages.dev/abu-dhabi-visa-decisions)
  - weekly Abu Dhabi reports, country scope and report dates.
- [Abuja visa decisions](https://irishvisaupdatetracker.pages.dev/abuja-visa-decisions)
  - weekly Abuja reports, country scope and report dates.
- [Ankara visa decisions](https://irishvisaupdatetracker.pages.dev/ankara-visa-decisions)
  - weekly Ankara reports, OCR notes and country scope.
- [Dublin visa decisions](https://irishvisaupdatetracker.pages.dev/dublin-visa-decisions)
  - Tuesday Dublin decisions, transferred applications and the Dublin queue.
- [Stamp 1G processing dates](https://irishvisaupdatetracker.pages.dev/stamp-1g-processing-dates)
  - the queue date ISD has reached, the lag, and how it has moved.
- [Employment permit processing dates](https://irishvisaupdatetracker.pages.dev/employment-permit-processing-dates)
  - the date reached in each published DETE permit category.
- [Irish visa processing times](https://irishvisaupdatetracker.pages.dev/visa-processing-times)
  - what the published queues show, and what they cannot tell you.
- [Method & sources](https://irishvisaupdatetracker.pages.dev/about#method) - how each office's
  figures are collected and checked, the official sources behind them and the limits of the data.
- [Monthly report](https://irishvisaupdatetracker.pages.dev/monthly-report) - the latest month’s
  dated decisions by office, with links to completed monthly archives.
- [Open data](https://irishvisaupdatetracker.pages.dev/data) - public JSON/CSV files, definitions,
  coverage, update cadence, reuse terms and a citation.
- [Data study](https://irishvisaupdatetracker.pages.dev/data-study) - an original study of
  published decisions by office, publication volume, New Delhi file growth and method limits.
- [Official report archive](https://irishvisaupdatetracker.pages.dev/reports) - every dated
  official report with counts, approval share, checksum and the published source file.
- [Publication schedule](https://irishvisaupdatetracker.pages.dev/when-are-visa-decisions-published)
  - expected windows per office, recent tracker observations, closures and calendar feeds.
- [Press & citation](https://irishvisaupdatetracker.pages.dev/press) - key statistics, methodology,
  reusable charts, licence terms and a citation snippet. DOI deposits require the maintainer's
  repository account.
- [Embed badge](https://irishvisaupdatetracker.pages.dev/embed) - static SVG badges for the latest
  official file, with no applicant-level data.
- [Data status](https://irishvisaupdatetracker.pages.dev/status) - office coverage, report dates,
  freshness and known snapshot limits.
- [About](https://irishvisaupdatetracker.pages.dev/about) - what is tracked, sources, limits.
- [Help & FAQ](https://irishvisaupdatetracker.pages.dev/help) - number formats, statuses,
  missing results, office coverage, alerts and checklists.
- [VFS tracking](https://irishvisaupdatetracker.pages.dev/vfs-tracking) - the official VFS Global
  tracking handoff for applications submitted in India, and what to do when a reference fails.
- [Contact](https://irishvisaupdatetracker.pages.dev/contact) - corrections, bug reports, scope.
- [Correction ledger](https://irishvisaupdatetracker.pages.dev/corrections) - source-linked file
  diffs, changed rows and a structured error-report link.
- [Privacy](https://irishvisaupdatetracker.pages.dev/privacy) - browser storage and form data.
- [Sitemap](https://irishvisaupdatetracker.pages.dev/sitemap.xml)
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/parth-soni-10/Irish-Visa-Tracker)

## Freshness and limits

The scraper runs on GitHub Actions and commits the data files; the site reads them, so the page
can update without a redeploy. GitHub's scheduled runs can land late, and the embassy does not
publish on weekends or public holidays. Always read `visa_meta.json` before saying the data is
current. Community timelines and projections are estimates, not official processing times.

- Email: soni.soni.parth@gmail.com (data corrections, privacy, general questions)
- GitHub issues: https://github.com/parth-soni-10/Irish-Visa-Tracker/issues
- Structured error report: https://irishvisaupdatetracker.pages.dev/contact#report-error
- Feedback form: https://irishvisaupdatetracker.pages.dev/contact#feedback
- Timeline form: https://irishvisaupdatetracker.pages.dev/contact#share-timeline

For an individual immigration case, contact the Embassy of Ireland in New Delhi, ISD or a
qualified immigration adviser. This project cannot intervene in an application.
